rightsNote: Use the screens to show the app in decks, documentation and store-style frames. Do not present them as photographs of a device, do not crop a mark out of them for reuse, and do not quote any name, figure, balance or address drawn in the design file as product data.
postProcessing: Each file is the export of one design-file frame at 1x: 391 by 828 pixels, 8-bit RGBA, the exterior of the rounded device shape fully transparent (all four corners and about 10 percent of the edge pixels), no semi-transparent pixels, no transparent row or column at any edge (a tight crop). Nothing was drawn, removed or scaled.

contract.description: Checked by node scripts/validate.mjs --only rasters and documented in assets/screenshots/mobile-app/README.md
contract.note: A real alpha channel with transparent exterior pixels and no empty margin, so the screens compose over any background without a halo
